item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera chews a piece of plain chapati for two minutes at home and notices that it begins to taste sweet. She then tests the chewed chapati with iodine solution. Which observation would best support the conclusion that her saliva has changed starch into sugar?

options.A: The chewed chapati turns blue-black with iodine, showing starch is still present.
options.B: The chewed chapati shows little or no blue-black colour with iodine, showing some starch has been changed into sugar.
options.C: The chewed chapati feels softer, showing that saliva has made it wet.
options.D: The chewed chapati tastes sweet only because chapati is naturally sweet.
